biography: ## About Global Corporate Real Estate & Development Professional Specializing in Data Center Site Selection, Market and Location Strategy, and Development. 10 years leading and directing strategic data center/tech site acquisition and development efforts while aligning with energy sourcing and innovative data center solutions. Over 25 years in corporate (in-house) real estate and development with experience across multiple asset classes (data centers, tech, industrial, healthcare, retail, office, and mixed use) and the asset lifecycle (acquisition, development, operations, and disposition). Served as in-house counsel representing the company as developer, landlord, and tenant.
